topic: Preliminary traffic data analysis and next steps
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered preliminary results for Fields based on signal levels of <=74, noting that the initial model was trained without citimedia manual countings data. For Field 15, manual countings indicated an increase in traffic. It was suggested that calculating this location during high-traffic times would be beneficial, and further analysis is needed to capture all people using elevators.

Later, it was confirmed that the meeting discussing results would be rescheduled for the afternoon of the following day, allowing time to analyze the current day's data.
decisions: The meeting to discuss preliminary results will take place the following afternoon.
action_items: Recalculate 3 months of data for all new models based on a signal level of 74.
